questions.label: Can multiple plugin panels on the same side be visible at once?
questions.help: Recommended: one visible plugin panel per side. Clicking another plugin icon on the same side replaces the visible panel, while hidden enabled plugins can still receive tool events.
options: One visible plugin panel per side; same-side icons replace the visible panel
Multiple same-side panels can stack or split
Only one plugin panel total can be visible across the whole shell

questions.label: Can left and right plugin panels be visible at the same time?
questions.help: Recommended: yes, one left and one right panel can be visible together, resizing toward the center pane minimum width.
options: Yes, one left and one right panel can be visible together
No, opening one side closes the other

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify whether hidden enabled plugin views should keep state warm, whether panel visibility persists after restart, or whether same-side replacement should preserve scroll/state.
